run.engine_version: m1.2b-2 (D-070 build; live shadow m1.2e / D-074; D-084 adopt) + m1.2i top-cell raise x1.0434
run.disclosure: Known bias (D-070): top-tier rushing runs ~2-4% low (star carry share −5.6%). Corrections are tested weekly against live results before adoption.

labels.kickoff_ts: kickoff (the live bundle's own stamp, UTC)
labels.injury_designation: T-90 designation the eligible set consumed
labels.injury_trend: T-90 practice trend the eligible set consumed
labels.line_label: the market snapshot label the forecast read

labels.line_spread: game line: spread, the team's own handicap (negative = favoured)
labels.line_implied_total: game line: this team's implied total — what the plays model reads
labels.team_carries: team carries: the rush-opportunity pool (TeamVolume.rush_opps), the official-carry denominator the carry share multiplies (§0A)
labels.qb_attempt_weight: his share of the team's pass attempts (the chain's passer split)
labels.yards_per_reception: yards per RECEPTION (PlayerMeans.yards_per_reception) — not per target
labels.yards_per_attempt: yards per pass ATTEMPT (the m1.2z per-attempt rate)
labels.td_rates: touchdown conversion by FIELD POSITION (league rates, pooled — D-086): {profile: {bucket: rate}} as ChainFit.td_rate holds it, applied by the chain as a mixture over the player's own bucket exposure
labels.td_rate_receiving: receiving touchdown conversion as ONE number (league rate) — never stored, because the chain has no such scalar
labels.td_rate_rushing: rushing touchdown conversion as ONE number (league rate) — never stored, because the chain has no such scalar

td_rate_receiving.reason: the touchdown conversion the chain applies is a rate PER FIELD-POSITION BUCKET — ChainFit.td_rate[(bucket, profile)], three buckets per profile, mixed over the player's own bucket exposure inside chain.expected_touchdowns — so no single number is the rate it applied to him. The WHOLE mapping is stored in `td_rates` instead; collapsing it into one float here would be this layer's average rather than the pass's rate
